items.title: France, UK and Spain see record temperatures as heatwave grips western Europe
items.description: Tens of millions of people are grappling with punishing temperatures, which have led to red heat alerts across the continent.

items.title: Air conditioning creates political divide after France records hottest day
items.description: France is being forced to re-think its longstanding reservations about air-conditioning as temperatures soar.

items.title: UN nuclear chief says inspectors will visit Iran sites as part of war deal
items.description: Rafael Grossi says the IAEA is "working on modalities" but an Iranian  minister says such access would only be part of a final deal with the US.

items.title: Clean sweep for Mamdani-backed candidates in New York's Democratic primary
items.description: Brad Lander unseats Dan Goldman in a race that laid bare the city's divisions over the Israel-Gaza war.

items.title: Biggest city in Crimea without power after Ukraine strikes
items.description: Sevastopol's Moscow-installed governor warns there will be no electricity in some areas until the evening.

items.title: France confirms first Ebola case
items.description: The French doctor had been working in DR Congo, where more than 260 people are known to have died.

items.title: French woman allegedly held captive by husband for 12 years rescued in Pakistan
items.description: Yasmina alleges she was held along with her five children, and they were all cut off from the outside world.

items.title: Colombia's left-wing presidential candidate concedes defeat
items.description: Senator Iván Cepeda was beaten by right-wing businessman Abelardo de la Espriella by less than a percentage point.

items.title: Sydney woman wakes from induced coma more than a week after shark attack
items.description: Leah Stewart, 34, had one of her arms amputated after she was bitten while swimming at Coogee Beach.

items.title: Eight sentenced to 450 years in prison over anti-ICE riot where officer was shot
items.description: An officer was shot in the neck during the Texas disorder by "Antifa Cell operatives", prosecutors said.

items.title: Bondi Beach shooting hero pleads not guilty to alleged assault on his father
items.description: Ahmed al Ahmed tackled one of the gunmen who killed 15 people at a Jewish event in December.

items.title: Kenya to charge students with murder over deadly school fire
items.description: Sixteen pupils, aged between 15 and 18, died when a fire broke out in a dormitory at Utumishi Girls' School last month.

claude-code.name: scaffold
claude-code.description: A TypeScript CLI that assembles AI-powered prompts at runtime to guide you from "I have an idea" to working software. Scaffold walks you through 54 structured pipeline steps — organized into 15 phases — and Codex, Claude Code, or Gemini handles the research, planning, and implementation for you.
